convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for unknown 'BrakeParb' indicator and includes external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, both requiring manual Python reimplementation

other_exits: Long position closed when DnTrend[0] is nonzero (trend reversal, no new sell signal)
Short position closed when UpTrend[0] is nonzero (trend reversal, no new buy signal)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM < 0 uses fixed lot size (abs(MM)), MM > 0 uses deposit fraction

custom_logic_notes: BrakeParb is a custom indicator with 4 buffers: buffer0=UpTrend, buffer1=DnTrend, buffer2=UpSignal, buffer3=DnSignal. Signal buffers appear to be binary (nonzero=active). When UpSignal fires, it opens long AND closes short. When DnSignal fires, it opens short AND closes long. Trend buffers provide exit-only signals without triggering opposing entry. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose wrappers with time-gated entry (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) and global variable management. The min_rates_total=3+2+1+2+SignalBar=8 bars required before trading. LoadHistory() call ensures bar data availability. SignalBar=1 means signals are read from the previous completed bar (not the current forming bar).
backtest_data_needs: Any symbol H4 730 days (symbol from chart at runtime)
python_conversion_notes: Must reverse-engineer or obtain BrakeParb indicator source to implement in Python. The indicator has 4 buffers with A=1.5, B=1.0, biginShift=10.0 parameters. TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions need simplified Python equivalents: BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen handle lot sizing (deposit fraction vs fixed lot), SL/TP placement, and time-gated order submission. BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose handle closing with deviation control. The entry logic is straightforward once BrakeParb signals are available: long on UpSignal, short on DnSignal, close long on DnTrend (no signal) or DnSignal, close short on UpTrend (no signal) or UpSignal. Recount mechanism on data errors must be handled.
